description: Bellamybuurt 1904-1905 speculative rows (Hasebroekstraat 4-36, Bellamyplein 22-38): dark brown brick, three axes on 5.3-5.7 m, segmental heads under brick relieving arches, the centre axis a stack of French windows with iron balconettes, a thin cornice band; over the centre axis a raised neck with a hoist beam, a flat-topped box dormer, or nothing

match.note: year and width carry it: every 1904-1905 pand of these rows is 5.3-5.7 m; Bellamyplein 18-20 (6.5 m, 1905) is out of the width fit

neck-hoist.note: Hasebroekstraat 26-36 (159125 160178 161486 163006 164522 167170): a raised neck over the centre axis, one attic light, the hoist beam's iron hooks on top

box-dormer.note: Hasebroekstraat 6, 10, 14 (160593, 154364, 164498): a wide flat-topped dormer over the centre axis

door-left.note: house door in the left axis (Hasebroekstraat 36)

door-right.note: house door in the right axis

rhythm.bays: 3 window axes, the centre one a French-window stack
rhythm.groundFloor: house door in an outer axis, two windows
rhythm.roofline: thin cornice band; a neck or a box dormer over the centre axis

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2022-01-04 pands 1-7: identical 3-axis fronts, centre balconette stack, neck crowns with hoist hooks
strip.jpg 2022-01-04 pands 12, 14, 16: the same front under a flat-topped box dormer
strip.jpg 2024-12-11 pands 1-4, 8-9: the same body; yellow-brick 166965 and 159962 take their measured wall

schemaLimits: the brick diamond and lozenge frieze under the cornice (Hasebroekstraat 6-16) is not drawn
the flared overhanging cap of the box dormers
Bellamyplein's square brick towers over an outer axis are drawn as the neck or box crown
notes: Palette: dark brown from the trim-normalised walls of hasebroek-2-46 (2022-01-04, overcast); every placed pand carries its own measured brick.
